subject: Priority of reactives (renders) - can I change it?

messages.author: c8fe4075ec631c03
messages.subject: Priority of reactives (renders) - can I change it?
parts:
I have accidentally set-up a feedback cycle (using my URL sync logic), where a long latency reactive executes before the URL reactive.

This means that if the user updates an input faster than the long latency reactive operates, the hash update reverts the input to the prior state, and then to the new state, and then to the prior state (ad infinitum).

Can I specify that the URL updating output (just a reactive) should be sent to the client before the long latency one?  

I vaguely recall a priority mechanism.

-Alex

messages.subject: Re: Priority of reactives (renders) - can I change it?
parts: > Can I specify that the URL updating output (just a reactive) should be sent to the client before the long latency one?

It's not possible right now, and it's not immediately clear to me how we would do that. Currently we only send anything to the client when the server is at "equilibrium" (all reactive observers that wanted to execute have finished executing) because otherwise the outputs could be in an inconsistent state.

Would a simple fix be to disable all inputs while the server is calculating?

Perhaps another fix would be to have the input change ONLY trigger the URL logic on the server, which would then send an output to the client, which would only then update the server state that causes the long calculation to run. (You could use Shiny.onInputChange(name, value) for this latter one, at least for prototyping)
